_comment: Requirements that enumerate a set of members. ODP-SA-06 has no per-requirement acceptance criteria -- its Trigger and Acceptance columns are the same boilerplate seventy-one times -- so nothing said whether the eighth constraint class or the fifth release mode was required. This file is the narrow substitute: for requirements that list N things, the N things are written down, each satisfied member names where it lives, and each absent member says so. Adding a requirement here is cheap; leaving a gap unwritten is what the check refuses.

requirements.statement: 系統必須考量資本、租約、施工、設備、人力、覆蓋、稀釋與時序硬限制。

members.name: DILUTION
members.note: A per-catchment cap on OPEN actions. Cannibalisation is pairwise between sites and the model is linear, so this is the part of the effect a count can carry, not the whole effect. DECIDED 2026-09-02: the full pairwise form is not pursued. Linearising it costs O(n^2) auxiliary variables, but the deciding reason is that the pairwise dilution coefficients are themselves model outputs carrying substantial uncertainty -- optimising precisely against uncertain coefficients manufactures precision the inputs do not support. The better next investment is the measurement: ODP-FR-HZ-004 absorption now produces realised dilution figures, and improving those changes the answer more than improving the optimisation over the current ones.

members.name: LEASE
members.note: Needs a per-option admissibility check (can this lease be signed or broken in the plan window, and at what penalty). No such data source is wired to the solver. Reported through ConstraintClass.LEASE in unmodelled_constraint_classes on every solve.

members.name: SEQUENCING
members.note: Needs a time dimension: per-period resource caps and precedence between actions. ActionOption.period_key is carried and reported but never constrained. DECIDED 2026-09-02: not modelled, and not scheduled. A per-period constraint is only worth having if per-period capacity data exists to feed it, and it does not -- construction and labour capacity are supplied to the solver as single totals. A constraint fed by a figure nobody measures is decorative, which is the pattern this work exists to remove. The risk it would have covered (a plan reported feasible while unschedulable) is already handled by ConstraintClass.SEQUENCING appearing in unmodelled_constraint_classes on every solve. Revisit when a planning cycle needs per-period sequencing AND the per-period capacity figures exist.

members.name: CHAMPION_CHALLENGER
members.note: Compares champion and challenger predictions against a tolerance and recommends rollback. Note this compares prediction agreement, not metrics against a baseline -- see ODP-FR-LH-005.

members.name: BACKTEST
members.note: run_rolling_backtest exists in models/shared_ml/backtest.py and is used by the training pipeline, but modules/learninghub references it nowhere. It is not a release mode, so a release cannot be gated on a backtest result.

members.name: ADJUST
members.note: Recommendation is CONTINUE/SCALE/STOP/CHANGE_CHANNEL/INCONCLUSIVE -- AdLift's vocabulary, which satisfies ODP-FR-AD-005 exactly and leaves no place for Adjust. InterventionStatus runs EXECUTING to OBSERVING to EVALUATING to COMPLETED with rollback as the only mid-course exit, so there is no state for 'modify and continue' either.

requirements.statement: 所有長時間任務都能查詢 QUEUED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED/PARTIAL。

members.name: PARTIAL
members.note: JobStatus in shared/governance/vocabularies.py now carries PARTIAL per ODP-FR-SHARED-001, but no job in the tree currently reports it. The vocabulary fork between queue.py and listings.py was resolved under ODP-JOBSTATUS-OUTCOME-VS-DELIVERY-001 by separating outcome from delivery mechanics.

requirements.statement: 系統必須組合 External Demand、Brand Transfer、Format Conversion、Ramp、Seasonality。

members.name: BRAND_TRANSFER
members.note: Two hits in the whole tree and neither is an implementation: a view name in tests/data/test_pit_snapshot.py, and a hard-coded brand_transfer_confidence of 0.76 in a sample payload in services/signal-store/client.py, which no product module imports.

members.name: FORMAT_CONVERSION
members.note: modules/site_economics/domain/formats.py::TargetFormatRegistry picks a store format by area. That is choosing a format, not converting an existing store from one to another; the simulator has no conversion path.

requirements.statement: 系統必須監控 Data/Feature/Prediction/Performance Drift。

members.name: FEATURE_DRIFT
members.note: Per-column drift from the same Evidently DataDriftPreset run; drifted_columns and drift_share carry it.

members.name: PREDICTION_DRIFT
members.note: Nothing monitors the distribution of model outputs. DataDriftPreset is the only preset used anywhere in the tree.

members.name: PERFORMANCE_DRIFT
members.note: Performance drift compares observed metrics against baseline_metrics using absolute/relative degradation thresholds and governed decision policies.

requirements.statement: 估值必須組合 GM_TTM、GM_FWD、折舊、資產、租約與正常化。

members.name: GM_TTM
members.note: Trailing-twelve-month gross margin enters normalize_margin at a 0.45 weight.

members.name: GM_FWD
members.note: Forward twelve-month gross margin enters normalize_margin at a 0.55 weight.

members.name: DEPRECIATION
members.note: No depreciation reaches the valuation path. The only depreciation in the tree is modules/site_economics/domain/simulator.py:325-357, where it is a tax shield on a greenfield store's projected cash flow -- a different quantity, on a different clock, for a different consumer -- and modules/avm does not import it. The contract, the AVM-specific verdict and its reasoning are in docs/design/ODP_AVM_DEPRECIATION_CONTRACT_2026-09-03.md; the executable spec is modules/avm/tests/test_avm_depreciation_contract.py.

members.name: ASSET
members.note: Asset book value and equipment_fair_value form the asset lens in value_store. Which of the two carries equipment, and whether it is already net of age, is the ambiguity section C-1 of the depreciation contract resolves.

members.name: LEASE
members.note: Lease liability is subtracted in the asset lens and published in its evidence block.

members.name: NORMALIZATION
members.note: Weighted TTM/forward blend with a named quality discount and recorded adjustment_reasons.
